title: 第284章头花生产线
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

看到外甥女的变化，陈卫东觉得很欣慰。

大丫刚显摆完，林婉秋从屋子里出来。

她今天一下午都在家翻译稿件，这会儿见陈卫东回来了，才放下手中的翻译工作，正好出来休息休息。

“东哥，今天上山的收获怎么样？”林婉秋顺口关心了一句。

今天进山的曲折，陈卫东就不打算和家里人说了。

毕竟杀了人，这要是让家人知道了，估计得吓住他们。

而且事情都已经解决了，这个秘密他守在自己的心里就行，没必要告知家里人，省得让他们担心他的情况。

曲折不能说，但是高兴的事情还是可以分享的。

陈卫东便冲林婉秋提了自己进山打到老虎这事儿。

若是别人进山能打死老虎，林婉秋可能会觉得很震惊。

但是听到她男人打到了一头老虎，林婉秋也仅仅是惊讶了片刻，并没觉得过于意外。

因为她知道，自己男人能一连对付那么多头野猪，收拾一头老虎似乎也没什么不可能的。

“东哥，这老虎可是一山之王，没想到你还能弄死一头老虎，实在太厉害了。”林婉秋说着，看着陈卫东的眼神中满是崇拜的光芒。

陈卫东笑了笑，“嗯，实力是一部分，今天的运气也不错，不然也没机会弄死野猪。”

陈家其他人在得知陈卫东今天上山还打死了一头老虎之后，高兴地同时又有些后怕。

尤其是张淑芬比较担心儿子的安危，她宁愿儿子少收获点野味都不愿意让他遇到危险。

不过幸好，儿子的实力强，没有出岔子。

这小子连带着一头大老虎都能给解决，这山上还有什么野兽是他对付不了的？

这么想着，张淑芬又稍微的心安了点。

儿子是个有能耐的，她不必太操心他。

张淑芬处理完了野鸡野兔，便由陈卫东负责烹饪了。

其实要不是张淑芬觉得自己的厨艺不如儿子，这会儿都有点想自己上手做饭，让儿子能继续歇一歇。

陈卫东将野鸡切成块炖上。

野鸡汤滋补，再加点儿养生药材进去，味道不差便能补身体。

林婉秋这妮子身体必须调养好。

之前她来月经的时候，痛经比较严重。

Page (1/3)

Chen Weidong felt very relieved to see the changes in his niece.

As soon as Daya finished showing off, Lin Wanqiu came out of the house.

She had been translating manuscripts at home all afternoon. When she saw Chen Weidong coming back, she put down her translation work and came out to rest.

"Brother Dong, how was your harvest from going up the mountain today?" Lin Wanqiu asked casually with concern.

Chen Weidong didn't plan to tell his family about the twists and turns of today's journey into the mountains.

After all, he killed someone, and if his family knew about it, they would probably be frightened.

And the matter has been resolved. He can just keep this secret in his heart. There is no need to tell his family to avoid making them worry about his situation.

I can’t talk about the twists and turns, but I can still share the happy things.

Chen Weidong mentioned to Lin Wanqiu that he went into the mountains and hunted tigers.

If someone could go into the mountains and kill a tiger, Lin Wanqiu might be shocked.

But when she heard that her man had shot a tiger, Lin Wanqiu was only surprised for a moment, but she didn't feel too surprised.

Because she knew that her man could deal with so many wild boars in a row, and it seemed that it was not impossible to deal with a tiger.

"Brother Dong, this tiger is the king of the mountain. I didn't expect you to be able to kill a tiger. It's so powerful." Lin Wanqiu said, looking at Chen Weidong with eyes full of admiration.

Chen Weidong smiled and said, "Well, strength is part of it. I am also lucky today, otherwise I would not have a chance to kill the wild boar."

After the other members of the Chen family learned that Chen Weidong went up the mountain today and killed a tiger, they were happy and a little scared at the same time.

Zhang Shufen is especially worried about her son's safety. She would rather her son harvest less game than put him in danger.

Fortunately, my son was strong and nothing went wrong.

This kid can even take down a big tiger. Is there any beast on this mountain that he can't deal with?

Thinking of this, Zhang Shufen felt a little more at ease.

Her son is capable, so she doesn't have to worry too much about him.

After Zhang Shufen finished handling the pheasants and rabbits, Chen Weidong took charge of cooking.

In fact, if Zhang Shufen hadn't felt that her cooking skills were not as good as her son's, she would have wanted to start cooking by herself right now so that her son could take a break.

Chen Weidong cut the pheasant into pieces and stewed them.

Pheasant soup is nourishing, and if you add some health-preserving herbs into it, it will not taste bad and can replenish your body.

This girl Lin Wanqiu must take good care of her body.

When she had her period before, the dysmenorrhea was severe.
